description: Stationnement 2 roues is a dataset listed in Ville de Meudon open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Seine Ouest. Localisation des aires de stationnement pour véhicules 2 roues (motos et vélos) sur Meudon Une aire de stationnement est un espace dédié au stationnement des véhicules 2 roues. Un espace peut compter plusieurs emplacements pour le stationnement. Coverage: Meudon. The portal files it under Stationnement, Transports, Déplacements, Mobilité, Vélo. Its keywords are Plan climat, 2 roues motorisées, 2RM, 2R, 2 roues, Ville d'Avray. The portal shows 185 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-meudon-fr-portal.
